title: Partner channel publish asset canvas and decision checklist
body:
Purpose
This is a compact, practical canvas + decision checklist to use when preparing partner-powered product tiles for cloud marketplaces (AWS/Azure/GCP) and channel partners. Designed to be used in a 30–60 minute run-through with the partner owner, product marketer, and platform engineer.

How to use
- Start with the Asset Canvas section to inventory the deliverables (copy, images, technical artifacts).
- Run the Decision Checklist (go/no-go) to score readiness.
- Surface blockers and assign owners in the Action table.
- Keep this doc as the single source for the preflight; link back to Confluence playbook for policy details.

ASSET CANVAS (quick inventory)
1) Tile copy (short title + 1-line summary)
   - Tile title (max 40 chars): Redwood Inference — Dedicated LLM Inference
   - Short summary (max 140 chars): Production-grade LLM inference with predictable latency, cost controls, and private deployments.
   - Long blurb (200–400 chars): Redwood Inference delivers a unified runtime for hosted, reserved, and private deployments—optimized for latency, throughput, and cost. Ship LLM features faster with per-route insights, rollout controls, and enterprise-grade compliance options.
   - CTA variants: Get started (trial), Contact sales, Request demo

2) Imagery / media
   - Hero image: 1200x627 PNG (brand-safe, no model-generated faces) — file: redwood-hero-matrix.png (owner: Marketing)
   - Icon: 128x128 SVG — redwood-icon.svg (owner: Design)
   - Screenshots: Console model dashboard (annotated) — three images, 1024x640 JPG each (owner: Product)
   - Video: optional 60s explainer (mp4) — hosted link required for marketplace listing

3) Technical artifacts
   - Integration guide PDF (one-pager): deployment modes, API examples, auth model (owner: Solutions Eng)
   - Billing SKU mapping spreadsheet: SKU codes + pricing tier mapping (owner: Finance)
   - Network & security brief: VPC/private deployment notes, compliance certifications (SOC2 summary) (owner: Security)
   - Support SLAs doc: support tiers + email/phone contact (owner: Customer Success)

4) Legal/compliance
   - Standard terms: link to Terms of Service and Data Processing Addendum (DPA)
   - Export control: review required for regulated geos (owner: Legal)
   - Privacy blurb: what data is stored/retained for hosted API (owner: Privacy)

5) Operational hooks
   - Onboarding flow: trial activation + sandbox limits
   - Metrics to display on tile: latency P50/P95, uptime SLA, throughput per GPU
   - Contact routing: partner success contact & escalation matrix

DECISION CHECKLIST (go/no-go)
Scoring: Yes/Partial/No. Anything with a No is a blocker. Partial -> document mitigation or timeline.
- Copy proofs: Title, short summary, long blurb approved by marketing (Yes/Partial/No)
- Imagery approved: brand + accessibility checks passed (Yes/Partial/No)
- Billing SKUs assigned and Finance sign-off (Yes/Partial/No)
- Integration doc present and validated against latest API (Yes/Partial/No)
- Security brief accepted by marketplace (SOC2 attestation present) (Yes/Partial/No)
- Legal terms linked and DPA available (Yes/Partial/No)
- Support contact & SLA entered (Yes/Partial/No)
- Compliance/regulatory flags cleared for target regions (Yes/Partial/No)

RISK MATRIX (quick)
- Branding risk: low/med/high (notes: ensure partner co-branding allowed under marketplace rules)
- Tech risk: low/med/high (notes: if private deployment needed in target region, leads time ~6 weeks)
- Revenue risk: low/med/high (notes: SKU mapping incomplete impacts billing launch)
- Legal risk: low/med/high (notes: region-specific data residency clauses)

ACTION TABLE (assignments)
- Fill in: artifact -> owner -> due date -> status -> blocker notes
  - Example row: "Billing SKU mapping" -> Finance (Owen Wu) -> 2024-12-05 -> in_progress -> waiting for final discount schedule
  - "Hero image" -> Design (Leah Martinez) -> 2024-11-27 -> done -> accepted
  - "Integration guide review" -> Solutions Eng (Priya Shah) -> 2024-12-03 -> in_review -> pending API sample updates (API-363)

MARKETPLACE COPY SNIPPETS (variants to A/B)
- Tile headline candidate A: "Run LLM inference with production SLAs"
- Tile headline candidate B: "Low-latency LLM inference for product teams"
- 1-liner candidate A: "Scale LLM features with predictable throughput and cost controls."
- 1-liner candidate B: "Unified inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments."
- Long description sample (use for catalog detail page): "Redwood Inference gives engineering teams a consistent runtime for LLMs—optimizing for latency, cost, and reliability. Choose hosted API for rapid prototyping, dedicated pools for committed throughput, or private deployments for regulated workloads. Built-in observability, rollout controls, and model optimization tooling reduce operational overhead so you can ship faster."

TECHNICAL GATES (must pass before publish)
- Auth flow validated: API key and OAuth examples tested (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/214)
- Rate limits and quota table present and documented
- Sample curl + SDK snippets included for Node/Python/Go
- Size limits confirmed for artifacts (images < 4MB, screenshots 72dpi)

MARKETPLACE-SPECIFIC NOTES
- AWS: need AMI or SaaS marketplace listing metadata (check product form fields for SaaS conditions). Confirm AWS seller account sticky terms with Legal.
- Azure: require Marketplace publisher validation; confirm offer category tags (AI Platform / Developer Tools). Ensure SKU plans show pricing intervals.
- GCP: ensure product resource URLs use https and follow publication naming guidelines.

SAMPLE CHECKS (quick)
- Accessibility: hero image alt text present -> alt: "Redwood Inference console showing model throughput dashboard"
- SEO: keywords present in long blurb -> "LLM inference, low latency, dedicated GPU, private deployment"
- Localization: mark fields that must be translated for EU/JP markets

UNRESOLVED QUESTIONS / OPEN DECISIONS
- Do we include a free trial tile for all marketplaces or only AWS? (impact: billing SKU gating)
- Can partner logos be co-hosted on tile or only a single publisher logo? Confirm with Marketplace PMs.
- Does the SOC2 summary suffice for EU-specific requirements or do we need additional attestations for certain customers?

TODO (short-term)
- [ ] Finalize SKU mapping and upload CSV to marketplace portal (owner: Owen Wu)
- [ ] Legal to sign off on tile copy and DPA link (owner: Marco Diaz)
- [ ] Create 60s explainer video (Marketing backlog) — target: 2024-12-15
- [ ] Link GH PR with docs and mark as integrated in Confluence playbook page (owner: Jordan Patel)

Notes & context
- This doc intends to be lightweight: keep the canvas at the top of the folder for quick edits during partner syncs. For policy-level detail, see the linked Confluence playbook.
- Past infra: our last marketplace publish (GTM-7012) needed an extra network diagram for Azure; anticipate similar request for private-deploy tile.

Versioning/History
- 2024-11-20: initial canvas created (Jordan Patel)
- 2024-12-03: added technical gates and sample copy (Priya Shah)
- 2025-01-14: updated imagery requirements and listed unresolved legal questions (Leah Martinez)
- 2025-02-01: current — prepping for partner approval review meeting

Quick links (for meeting)
- Playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/GTMP/Marketplace+Publishing+Playbook
